title: Calculate metrics for different K values
notes: real-book-syntax-bug: `if rel == 1:` (md line 536) has no indented body, so `relevant_found += 1` sits at the same indent -> IndentationError; the listing does not parse. Beyond the syntax bug the AP loop is dedented out of the `for` (ap only counts the last position) and the else/append lines are mis-indented; annotation letters are duplicated/misaligned (#B,#C,#D repeated). Metric logic also diverges from the shipped package (see FINDINGS): AP divides by np.sum(top_k_rel) (=hits) vs package min(len(relevant),k); and NDCG is computed as ndcg_score([ideal_rel],[top_k_rel]) which mis-orders y_true/y_score and inflates NDCG. Needs sklearn.ndcg_score + the eval-pipeline vars; compile-checked only.
